title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
goal: Solve Kth Largest Element in an Array: Maintain a size-k min-heap while scanning numbers; heap root is the kth largest.
strategy: Maintain a size-k min-heap while scanning numbers; heap root is the kth largest.
edgeCases: Duplicates occupy separate ranks; kth largest is not kth distinct largest.
inputRules: k must be between 1 and len(nums)
